__comment: Profession data read by DwarfAssets.
promotion_screen: career-map entries (role, position, summary, availability, optional starter_tool).
work_permissions: per-dwarf work categories and the task types each covers.
experience_thresholds: cumulative counts for levels 2-5, for a career that earns experience without its own.
professions: icon (one Hearthblock picture shared by the career map, the equipment view and Crafters, doc 259),
display_name, promotes_from, promotion_enabled, required_tool, equipment_preview;
stats: the main and the second stat (data/entities/dwarves/stats.json), for the career map's fit (doc 41);
work: the task types a career does instead of the common work (Task.COMMON_WORK), in the order it does them:
work it could start earlier in the list keeps an idle dwarf from later work (doc 292); none names the common work;
work_first: the task types a career that takes the common work does before it (doc 293: the Carpenter's and the
Stonemason's crafting): an idle dwarf whose first work is waiting takes no common work meanwhile;
craft_section: the crafting section (worker_crafting.json) whose orders the career makes; craft_tool: the hand tool its
crafting swing holds in place of the axe; craft_work: the kind of work its crafting counts as for the stats (the
Stonemason's 'stonework' is Strength's); craft_sound: the strike its crafting makes ('hammer', else the axe's chop);
experience: a career that earns it (doc 41): earned_by (the task type that earns one), noun (what is counted),
per (how it is earned), master (the level 5 title), to_go (the career map's count to the next level), noun_one and
to_go_one (the same for a count of one, where the plural differs: '1 batch made', '1 more batch'), disabled
(the roster's note with its work off), optional thresholds, catch_log (the sheet shows the Ranger's log, doc 292),
and rewards: {level, text} with what the level gives (big_chance, season_speed); level 1's text is the focus.
work_speed_bonus_per_level: less work time for each level above 1, at the career's own work: the Miner's digging, the
Carpenter's and the Stonemason's crafting; its rewards read experience.speed_text (default: less digging time).
Planned profession design (tasks, rooms, level perks) is in docs/40_economy_colony/41_dwarf_agents.md.

promotion_screen.summary: A versatile colony member. Mines, gathers, hauls, builds and crafts basic goods.
promotion_screen.availability: No requirements. Return to Worker at any time.

promotion_screen.summary: Keeps the tunnels moving. Prioritizes mining within work priorities, then helps with permitted general work.
Plants, tends and harvests cultivated crops. Planned support for fields, underground crops and beehives.
promotion_screen.availability: Planned: farming and tool equipping are not available yet.

promotion_screen.summary: Fishes the colony's waters and dries the catch on the rack. Hunting comes later.
promotion_screen.availability: Requires one available Ranger's kit. Promotion completes after the dwarf collects it.

promotion_screen.summary: Works timber with basic tools at the carpenter's bench, which they make first. Helps with general colony work when there is nothing to make.
promotion_screen.availability: Requires one available carpentry kit. Promotion completes after the dwarf collects it.

promotion_screen.summary: Shapes rough stone at the mason's bench, which they make first. Helps with general colony work when there is nothing to make.
promotion_screen.availability: Requires one available crude masonry kit. Promotion completes after the dwarf collects it.

promotion_screen.summary: Smelts ore and forges the colony's metal tools, hardware, weapons and armor.
promotion_screen.availability: Planned: requires smelting, forging and tool equipping.

work_permissions.label: Haul
work_permissions.description: Unrelated hauling to storage. Carrying supplies for another permitted job stays allowed.

work_permissions.label: Gather
work_permissions.description: Chop trees, gather stone, harvest wild plants and clear or uproot plants.

work_permissions.label: Mine
work_permissions.description: Mine designated terrain. Miners gain experience for completed blocks.

work_permissions.label: Build
work_permissions.description: Place and remove furniture, ladders and plants, including carrying their supplies.

work_permissions.label: Craft
work_permissions.description: Craft the career's own recipes: Workers at the workbench; Carpenters and Stonemasons their own, before other work; Rangers hang fish on the drying rack and take them down dried.

work_permissions.label: Fish
work_permissions.description: Fish from Fishing zones until the colony keeps enough fish. Rangers only.

experience_thresholds.__comment: Cumulative counts; the level is derived at runtime and only the raw count is saved. A career's own experience.thresholds replace these.

equipment_preview.default_description: Standard tools for general colony work. No crafted upgrade equipped.
equipment_preview.upgrade_description: Carpenters, Stonemasons and Rangers collect their kits when promoted. Other specialist tool careers are planned.
equipment_preview.upgrade_method: Craft a kit under Rudimentary › Starter tools, then choose the career in Profession.

base:profession:worker.description: The foundation of every dwarven colony. Workers haul goods, clear rubble, and fill in wherever a specialist is unavailable. Every dwarf begins as a Worker and retains this as a fallback when reassigned.

equipment_preview.default_description: Standard mining tool. No equipment bonus; Miner experience improves digging speed separately.
equipment_preview.upgrade_description: Future Blacksmith-made upgrade. Planned chance to mine 2–3 marked voxels per strike; balance is not finalized.
equipment_preview.upgrade_method: Planned: craft the upgrade with a Blacksmith, then assign the finished tool here. Your dwarf collects it and returns the old tool.

base:profession:miner.description: Breaks stone, carves tunnels, and expands the colony's underground domain. The colony's primary engine of growth.

experience.per: One experience per completed block. Walking speed stays unchanged.

equipment_preview.default_description: A Ranger's kit is required for this profession.

base:profession:ranger.description: Lives off the wild for the colony: fishes its waters and dries the catch, and will hunt once hunting comes.

experience.per: One experience per catch. Levels make catches bigger, not faster.

rewards.text: One catch in six is a big fish
Patient: winter slows them half as much
One catch in three is big
Almost every other catch is big

equipment_preview.default_description: A crude masonry kit is required for this profession.
equipment_preview.upgrade_description: Future Blacksmith-made upgrade beyond the maul and stone point, for dressed stone and a better bench.
equipment_preview.upgrade_method: Planned: craft the upgrade with a Blacksmith, then assign the finished tool here. Your dwarf collects it and returns the old tool.

base:profession:stonemason.description: Shapes rough stone with a maul and a stone point at the mason's bench, which they make first. Dressed stone waits for better tools.

experience.per: One experience per batch made on the Stonemason's own page.

base:profession:farmer.description: Plants, tends, and harvests all crops — both underground cave soil plots and surface dirt fields. Also responsible for tending beehives.

equipment_preview.default_description: A crude carpentry kit is required for this profession.
equipment_preview.upgrade_description: Future Blacksmith-made upgrade beyond the mallet and stone adze, for sawn planks and a better bench.
equipment_preview.upgrade_method: Planned: craft the upgrade with a Blacksmith, then assign the finished tool here. Your dwarf collects it and returns the old tool.

base:profession:carpenter.description: Works timber with a mallet and a stone adze at the carpenter's bench, which they make first. Planks wait for a saw.

experience.per: One experience per batch made on the Carpenter's own page.

base:profession:blacksmith.description: Smelts raw ore into metal ingots and forges tools, hardware, weapons, armor and shields. The colony's only metalworking profession.
